title: Flatness descends to localized quotients
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $J\subset R$ an ideal, $q_0\subset S/JS$ a prime, $q$ its inverse image in $S$, $p=q\cap R$, and $p_0=q_0\cap(R/J)$. If $R_p\to S_q$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then $(R/J)_{p_0}\to(S/JS)_{q_0}$ is flat. All localizations are at the complements of the indicated primes [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime].

source.place: Lemma 07FE (lemma-resolve-special), proof, final paragraph: flat local parameter quotients and their separable residue extension

proof.text: Localization is flat. Compose R→R_p with the assumed flat local map to get R→S_q flat. The algebraOfLiesOver tower identifies the composite with the canonical map.

Identify S_q/JS_q with (R/J)⊗_R S_q by quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor. Flat base change gives flatness over R/J. The two expressions for JS_q, mapped directly from R and through S, agree by Ideal.map_map and the scalar tower.

The quotient localization instance and the prime-complement image identity make S_q/JS_q a localization of S/JS at q₀. IsLocalization.algEquiv identifies it with (S/JS)_{q₀}. Its restriction to R/J is an algebra equivalence, so flatness transports.
Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization converts flatness over R/J to flatness over (R/J)_{p₀}; the canonical lies-over algebra supplies the scalar tower.

theorem flat_localized_quotient_of_flat_localRingHom
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (J : Ideal R) (q₀ : PrimeSpectrum (S ⧸ J.map (algebraMap R S)))
    (hflat : (Localization.localRingHom
      ((q₀.asIdeal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.map (algebraMap R S)))).under R)
      (q₀.asIdeal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.map (algebraMap R S))))
      (algebraMap R S) rfl).Flat) :
    letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver
      (q₀.asIdeal.under (R ⧸ J)) q₀.asIdeal
    RingHom.Flat (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime (q₀.asIdeal.under (R ⧸ J)))
      (Localization.AtPrime q₀.asIdeal))
